C268 admits the exact original `before` and `after` source/GLB inputs before invoking the finite C267 hinge declaration comparator. This completes the fourth interface under the unchanged C260 contract.

The reader checks original file sizes and hashes with bounded reads, rejects unsafe or inaccessible paths, and passes captured bytes to pinned comparison dependencies. The existing raw interfaces still support changed inputs; historical admission remains a separate boundary.

## Reviewed implementation and recovered evidence

Implementation candidate: `e6f55b73fa71953aa648bcd34711a6796a7346b6`.
Current integration candidate: `43115fb864c6f475fb2a56da43566fc1c8b3af50`.

Independent review accepts R01–R05 with no mandatory finding. The corrected candidate passed 12 groups, 282 test methods and 14 corpus bindings on CPython 3.12.14 / Linux. Its C268 controls include 35 methods and 131 calls: 12 historical admissions, nine raw successes and 110 typed refusals.

The interrupted session's accepted evidence commit `ffb912cce59ccfe7d0d82ab4349de9b12271cc03` is preserved in the verified recovery bundle. Publication commit `b49a930292752e80abe47cc0526e76413089d64d` has exactly the same complete tree, `10bcebf566d001a850f8e5c5c77eb96857de7e3b`. Original execution and review identities are retained. Independent recovery audits verified the exact evidence and input continuity.

Current finalization records reconcile the existing task, main changes, integration ownership and confirmed early recovery save. Fresh documentation/workflow checks passed on exact candidate tree `07971fcdbc6d912febc6adbec7ebf576eccab43f`; their execution receipts will be preserved with the resulting-main evidence.

## Completion boundary

Scope issue: #265. After integration, execute the complete affected cohort on actual main, verify retained branch history and disposition, save the verified final handoff and prompts, publish a separate delivery receipt, then close the task and stop. These remain separate gates; this PR does not close the issue automatically.

Qualification covers exact historical byte admission and finite declaration agreement. Full C260 H-group qualification, site/world behavior, accepted revisions, invalid-edit atomicity, clean rebuilds, native/model trials and comparative benefit remain separate. Historical failures and failed attempts remain preserved.
